newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL blue chips seen extending consolidation.
newsitem.headline: KL blue chips seen extending consolidation.

text.p: Kuala Lumpur blue-chip shares are likely to extend their consolidation on Thursday following further losses on Wall Street, dealers said.
The Dow fell 36 points on Wednesday, its biggest point loss in one month, on earnings jitters.
"I expect blue chips to continue their drift but falls will be limited as selling has been quite well absorbed," said one institutional dealer.
Dealers said Wednesday's election results of the youth and women wings of the ruling United Malays National Organisation were unlikely to influence market sentiment.
